data:
Decision: NO-GO. Win probability: 1.8%.

Top probability drivers: (1) Low expected evaluation score (66.3) is the dominant drag—materially below what’s typically needed to be competitive. (2) Three compliance gaps reduce responsiveness and scoring headroom, increasing disqualification/penalty risk. (3) Budget level (PKR 150M; log 5.017) slightly hurts fit—suggesting a mismatch versus where we tend to be most competitive; limited response time (191.5 hrs) further constrains quality, only marginally offset by a relatively short tender (42 pages).

Mandatory gaps and what closing them takes: Bid security of 2% required. To close: obtain an unconditional bank guarantee/call deposit for 2% of bid value, align validity with bid validity period, ensure correct beneficiary wording, and have legal/finance review; requires cash/credit line allocation and bank lead time.

Recommendation: Do not bid unless bid security can be issued immediately and we can raise the expected score materially; otherwise conserve resources.
